caption: How Scoliosis Surgery is Done?  (3D Animation)        #how #scoliosis #surgery #recovery #3danimation
cues: Ever wonder how scoliosis surgery actually straightens the spine?
Scoliosis causes the spine to curve and rotate,
and when surgery is recommended,
the most common procedure is spinal fusion.
First, the patient is placed under general anesthesia
so they're completely asleep.
The surgeon then makes an incision along the back
to access the curved part of the spine.
Using specialized imaging and monitoring,
screws and rods are carefully placed into the vertebrae
to help correct the spinal alignment.
The surgeon gradually adjusts the rods to improve the curve
while protecting the spinal cord and nerves throughout the procedure.
Bone graft material is then placed along the spine,
which helps the vertebrae gradually fuse together into one
solid section. Once everything is in position,
the incision is closed. The surgery can take several hours,
and recovery happens gradually over the following weeks and months.
